seo.title: Best Rooftop Bars in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's best rooftop bars! From chic hotel lounges to vibrant open-air terraces, find the perfect spot for stunning city views, delicious cocktails, and unforgettable nights. Your guide to Casablanca's elevated nightlife.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's skyline offers a surprising array of sophisticated and lively rooftop bars, perfect for enjoying a sunset drink, panoramic city views, or a stylish night out. Experience the city's pulse from above.

picks.name: The View (Sofitel Casablanca Tour Blanche)
picks.neighborhood: City Center / Place des Nations Unies
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched atop the iconic Sofitel Tour Blanche, The View offers breathtaking 360-degree vistas of Casablanca, including the Hassan II Mosque and the sprawling cityscape. It's a truly luxurious spot for a sophisticated evening, with a curated selection of premium spirits and creative cocktails.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Mojito Royal' while watching the sunset over the Atlantic, paired with their gourmet mini-tagines.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table in advance, especially on weekends, to secure the best spots with a direct view of the Hassan II Mosque. Dress code is smart casual.
picks.redditQuote: "Seriously, The View at Sofitel is unreal. The cocktails are pricey but the sunset over the mosque is worth every dirham. Go there for a special occasion."

picks.name: Sky Bar (Hyatt Regency Casablanca)
picks.neighborhood: City Center / Place des Nations Unies
picks.whyItMadeTheList: An enduring classic, Sky Bar at the Hyatt Regency boasts an open-air terrace with a lively yet chic atmosphere. It's a popular spot for both locals and travelers seeking a vibrant evening under the stars. Expect quality drinks, good music, and a stylish crowd.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature 'Casablanca Sling' cocktail, a refreshing twist on a classic, accompanied by their mezze platter.
picks.insiderTip: The bar can get quite busy after 9 PM. Arrive earlier for a more relaxed experience and to secure a good lounge spot. They often have live DJs.
picks.redditQuote: "Sky Bar at the Hyatt is always a good time. Great vibe, decent drinks, and you can actually feel like you're out in a proper club setting on a rooftop."

picks.name: Narval Sky Lounge (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Offering a more serene and exclusive experience, Narval Sky Lounge is part of the luxurious Four Seasons Hotel, situated directly on the Corniche. It provides stunning panoramic ocean views, a sophisticated ambiance, and an exquisite menu of seafood bites and meticulously crafted cocktails. Ideal for a romantic evening.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Gin Basil Smash' with fresh local ingredients, paired with their delicate seafood ceviche.
picks.insiderTip: This is a more tranquil and upscale setting. Best visited for a quiet, intimate evening. The sunset views over the Atlantic are truly spectacular.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're looking for something really classy and oceanfront, Narval at the Four Seasons is it. Pricey, but the service and the views are top-notch."

picks.name: La Terrasse Verte (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 27th floor of one of Casablanca's iconic Twin Towers, La Terrasse Verte offers a verdant escape with good city views. It's a more relaxed and spacious rooftop, blending lush greenery with contemporary design. Perfect for unwinding after a day of sightseeing.
picks.whatToOrder: Try their 'Moroccan Mint Julep' for a local twist, along with some traditional Moroccan appetizers.
picks.insiderTip: While not as high-end as some other options, it offers a great value for the views and atmosphere. Look out for themed nights or happy hour specials.
picks.redditQuote: "La Terrasse Verte is surprisingly chill for a rooftop bar in the Twin Center. Good for a casual drink, and the views are decent without breaking the bank."

picks.name: Sky 28 (Twin Center)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated on the 28th floor of the West Tower, Sky 28 is more of a panoramic lounge than an open-air rooftop, but it offers some of the most expansive city views in Casablanca. The sophisticated interior, live music, and diverse menu of international small plates make it a popular evening destination.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of fine Moroccan wine (like Domaine de Sahari) and their 'Assortment de Tapas' to share.
picks.insiderTip: It's indoors, so it's a great option for cooler evenings or when you prefer a climate-controlled environment with a view. Perfect for pre-dinner drinks.
picks.redditQuote: "Sky 28 is classic Casablanca. You go for the views from way up high. It's not a 'rooftop' rooftop, but the panoramic windows make up for it. Good for a chill evening."

picks.name: The Rooftop Bar (Mövenpick Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A vibrant and modern rooftop bar located at the Mövenpick Hotel, offering a comfortable setting with city views and often featuring a pool area. It’s known for its friendly service, refreshing drinks, and relaxed ambiance, making it a great spot for both daytime lounging and evening cocktails.
picks.whatToOrder: Their 'Mövenpick Sunset Spritz' and a selection of fresh fruit skewers or light Mediterranean bites.
picks.insiderTip: Check if they have 'ladies' nights' or special themed events, as these can offer great deals and add to the lively atmosphere. The pool area makes it feel like a mini-resort.
picks.redditQuote: "The Mövenpick rooftop is surprisingly cool. Not super fancy but a nice vibe, decent music, and the drinks are fairly priced for a hotel. Good for a casual meet-up."

picks.name: Seven Rooftop Bar (ONOMO Hotel Casablanca City Center)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Seven Rooftop Bar brings a fresh, contemporary African-inspired vibe to Casablanca's rooftop scene. Located at the ONOMO Hotel, it offers a vibrant atmosphere, unique cocktails, and a modern design. It’s a great choice for those looking for something a bit different and stylish.
picks.whatToOrder: Try one of their signature cocktails with African-inspired ingredients, like a 'Spice Route Martini', along with their gourmet sliders.
picks.insiderTip: The ONOMO hotel is known for its modern, African-influenced design. This aesthetic extends to the rooftop bar, making for a distinctive visual experience. Good for trend-seekers.
picks.redditQuote: "ONOMO's Seven Rooftop is actually pretty cool. It's new, the decor is fresh, and the cocktails are creative. Definitely a spot to check out if you're bored of the old regulars."

picks.name: Roof Top Bar & Restaurant (Hotel Art Palace & Suites)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: At the Hotel Art Palace & Suites, this rooftop offers a blend of Moroccan elegance and contemporary comfort. The intimate setting provides a charming backdrop for drinks and dining, with a focus on fresh, quality ingredients and attentive service. It's a hidden gem for a quieter, sophisticated evening.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Old Fashioned' paired with their exquisitely prepared lamb tagine bites or mini pastries.
picks.insiderTip: This venue is known for its artistic decor and more intimate atmosphere. It’s a good choice if you prefer a less crowded and more elegant rooftop experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Found the rooftop at Hotel Art Palace by chance. Super underrated! The decor is gorgeous, and the cocktails are well made. A bit hidden but worth it."

picks.name: Dar El Bacha Rooftop (Anfa Place Living Resort)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located within the Anfa Place Living Resort, Dar El Bacha Rooftop offers stunning ocean views and a relaxed, resort-style ambiance. It's an excellent choice for those looking to escape the city's hustle and enjoy a seaside breeze with their drinks. The decor often incorporates traditional Moroccan elements.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing 'Mint Tea Mojito' to complement the sea air, or a glass of chilled Moroccan rosé.
picks.insiderTip: Perfect for a leisurely afternoon drink or an early evening sunset view, especially if you're staying nearby on the Corniche. The resort setting adds to its tranquility.
picks.redditQuote: "Dar El Bacha rooftop is so chill. It's right on the water basically, part of the Anfa Place resort. Great spot to relax and watch the waves with a drink."

picks.name: Le Vertigo (Hotel Golden Tulip Farah Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Vertigo offers elevated city views from the Golden Tulip Farah, situated close to the port and the old medina. It's a solid choice for a good perspective of central Casablanca, with a straightforward menu of international drinks and comfort food. Often hosts events and has a lively buzz.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Margarita' and their crispy calamari, perfect for sharing.
picks.insiderTip: Its location near the port means you might get unique views of maritime activity. Check for any live music nights, as they can be quite popular.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Vertigo is a decent option, especially if you're around the port area. Nothing too fancy, but good drinks and a nice view of the city hustle and bustle."

picks.name: L'Ambiance Restaurant & Lounge (Hotel Val d'Anfa)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While primarily a restaurant, L'Ambiance at Hotel Val d'Anfa features a lovely terrace with sea views, making it a great spot for pre-dinner drinks or a relaxed evening cocktail. It offers a sophisticated setting with a focus on refined French and Mediterranean cuisine, complemented by an extensive wine list.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of crisp white wine or a Kir Royale, paired with their selection of artisanal cheeses.
picks.insiderTip: More of a relaxed, dining-oriented experience, but the terrace is excellent for drinks. Arrive before sunset to enjoy the stunning ocean panorama.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Ambiance has this really nice terrace with ocean views. It's technically a restaurant but we just went for drinks and it was super classy and chill."

picks.name: Buddha-Bar Casablanca
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Though not a traditional open-air rooftop, Buddha-Bar Casablanca offers an expansive, multi-level terrace that creates an elevated and exotic lounge experience. Known for its opulent decor, chill-out music, and sophisticated Pan-Asian fusion menu, it's a global hotspot that brings its signature vibe to Casablanca. It's perfect for a lavish night out.
picks.whatToOrder: Their famous 'Buddha-Bar Cocktail' or a 'Passion Fruit Martini,' accompanied by a selection of sushi rolls or dim sum.
picks.insiderTip: Buddha-Bar is more about the complete sensory experience – music, decor, and cocktails. It's a great choice for a full evening out rather than just a quick drink. Dress to impress.
picks.redditQuote: "Buddha-Bar Casablanca is exactly what you'd expect: expensive, chic, and great music. Not a traditional rooftop but the outdoor terrace feels just as cool, especially if you like that vibe."

faq.question: What is the best time of year to visit Casablanca's rooftop bars?
faq.answer: The best time to enjoy Casablanca's rooftop bars is during spring (April-May) and autumn (September-October) when the weather is pleasantly mild and skies are generally clear. Summer evenings (June-August) can also be wonderful, though it can be quite warm during the day. Winters can be cool and rainy, making indoor panoramic bars more suitable.

faq.question: Do Casablanca's rooftop bars have a dress code?
faq.answer: Many of Casablanca's upscale rooftop bars, especially those in luxury hotels, enforce a smart casual or elegant dress code. For men, this usually means collared shirts and trousers (no shorts or sandals), and for women, stylish dresses or smart attire. It's always best to check with the specific venue beforehand if you're unsure, especially for top-tier establishments.

faq.question: Are rooftop bars in Casablanca expensive?
faq.answer: Prices at Casablanca's rooftop bars vary significantly. While more luxurious hotel rooftops can be quite expensive, with cocktails ranging from 120-180 MAD ($12-18), there are also mid-range options where drinks are more affordable, around 80-120 MAD ($8-12). Expect to pay a premium for the views and ambiance compared to ground-level establishments.

faq.question: Do Casablanca's rooftop bars serve alcohol?
faq.answer: Yes, all the listed rooftop bars in Casablanca, particularly those located in international hotels or licensed establishments, serve alcohol including cocktails, wine, beer, and spirits. Morocco is a Muslim country, but alcohol consumption is permitted in licensed venues catering to tourists and locals alike. You won't have any issue finding alcoholic beverages at these locations.

faq.question: Can I visit Casablanca's rooftop bars with children?
faq.answer: Most upscale rooftop bars in Casablanca are primarily geared towards adults and often have an age restriction (e.g., 18+ or 21+) after certain evening hours, especially if they transition into a lounge or club atmosphere. During the daytime or early evening, some hotel rooftops might be more accommodating, but it's always advisable to call ahead and confirm their policy on children before visiting.

faq.question: Are reservations necessary for rooftop bars in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Reservations are highly recommended for popular rooftop bars in Casablanca, especially if you plan to visit on a weekend evening or if you want a specific table with the best view. For top-tier venues like The View or Narval Sky Lounge, booking in advance is almost essential to avoid disappointment. For more casual spots, you might be able to walk in, but a quick call is always a good idea.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best rooftop bars is based on extensive research, including expert reviews, local recommendations, and firsthand visits. We prioritize venues offering exceptional views, quality beverages and food, a unique atmosphere, and excellent service, ensuring a memorable elevated experience for every traveler.
